name: Frankfurt-Hahn Airport
before:
Despite the name, this airport sits nowhere near Frankfurt. It is out in the hills of Rhineland-Palatinate, in the municipality of Hahn, roughly 120km by road from Frankfurt and the same distance again from Luxembourg. Koblenz is the closest major city at about 70km, with Mainz around 90km away. Kirchberg is the nearest town, some 10km up the road, and Simmern and Traben-Trarbach are both about 20km out.

Ryanair and Wizz Air run most of the passenger flights, and it was Ryanair that asked for the Frankfurt prefix back in 2001. The Triwo Travvex Group took over in 2023 and reverted the name to Hahn Airport, though German air traffic control still lists it as Frankfurt-Hahn. Either way, clients should expect a transfer rather than a quick hop into the city.

It is a working cargo hub as much as a passenger terminal, helped by a 24-hour operating licence that keeps freight moving through the night. The scale is modest and the setting rural, so it feels closer to a regional airfield than an international gateway. Worth flagging journey times to clients at the booking stage.

Ryanair and Wizz Air run its passenger flights. The airport has called itself Hahn Airport again since Triwo bought it in May 2023, but expect to see the Frankfurt-Hahn name too. Either way, clients should expect a transfer rather than a quick hop into the city.
